text:
maya (support): Escalating Ascendia onboarding — SSO callback fails and provisioning returned 403. Renewal in ~28 days; marking high priority if we don't resolve today.
liam (cs): Understood. Can you paste the exact error and any logs/screenshots?
maya (support): Customer sees browser error: `ACS mismatch` during SAML callback. Our provision API returned 403 when creating dedicated capacity. Screenshot added. They changed IdP config yesterday.
liam (cs): Assigning @sara for customer comms and @raj for immediate triage. I'll loop sales if it looks risky.
sara (cs): I'll send a short hold message to the customer and give ETA 30m.
raj (eng): Looking at tenant routing: tenant asc-001 didn't bind after their rekey; provisioner couldn't resolve tenant route so it rejected with 403. I'm triggering a reseed: `/usr/local/bin/reseed-tenant --tenant asc-001 --region=us-east1`
deploy-bot: reseed job queued (job-id: rs-5123) for tenant asc-001
maya (support): Reseed ran. Customer reported 403 for ~15s then provision API returned 200.
liam (cs): Good. Sara, please prepare a customer-friendly explanation: what failed, what we did, and monitoring plan. Also propose goodwill credit if tone warrants.
sara (cs): Draft message: "Hi Elena — thanks for flagging. Two things caused the interruption: 1) your IdP's ACS URL mismatch with our tenant config (we synced it), and 2) a transient routing issue after your key rotation caused provisioning to fail (we reseeded your tenant). Both issues are resolved. Please retry SSO and confirm; we'll monitor for 24 hours. We can also extend your trial by 2 weeks if you'd like." Sending now.
anna (sales): Heads-up — Ascendia is in an active expansion playbook, onboarding completion ties to the Q next-quarter upsell. Please update me if renewal becomes at risk.
raj (eng): I'll monitor provisioner logs for 3 hours: `journalctl -u provisioner -f | grep asc-001` and set an alert if 403/ERROR reappears.
maya (support): Customer replied: "SSO worked and onboarding finished. Appreciate the quick help." (reply arrived ~18m after fix)
sara (cs): Updated CRM: onboarding status -> "Completed", renewal risk -> "Low"; noted offer of trial extension (declined). Added a short postmortem entry: cause = IdP ACS mismatch + transient tenant routing after key rotation; remediation = reseed + improved error messaging.
liam (cs): Closing escalation. Action items: Sara - final comms + CRM update + PM entry; Raj - 3h monitoring; Maya - follow customer alerts; Liam - notify renewal and sales. Thanks everyone :tada:
